founder.quote: A hobby that became a life. I am in the kitchen every morning before the boutique opens, and I would not have it any other way.
founder.name: Karina Krasovitskaya
founder.bio: Since June 4th, 2013, Karina has spent every morning in the Arbooz kitchen - developing the seasonal menu, training the team, and arranging the counter before the first customer arrives at eleven.
